query:
select
                sales_start,
                tickets_been_released,
                exists (
                    select 1 from purchases where product_id = $1
                ) as "has_buyers!",
                array(
                    select activity_id from product_activity_assignments
                    where product_id = $1
                ) as "activity_ids!: Vec<Uuid>"
            from products
            where id = $1
            for update
